## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can omit matching files through its environment. Add coverage for literal basename patterns on nested files.

## Changes
The CLI adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that filters files by basename before archiving and logs skipped paths at INFO level. The pull request also documents the option and adds parser, collection, and archive tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns an empty pattern list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says every new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set only the environment variable still include matching log files in their archives.

## Suggestions
- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test literal basename matching for nested files — The tests never exercise `--exclude debug.log` against `sub/debug.log`. Their leading-wildcard patterns also match full paths, so passing the full path to the matcher would pass the existing assertions. — A regression to full-path matching could leave nested files in archives despite a matching basename exclusion. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with a nested file and a literal basename pattern.
